question: Should assistant-message plain-text copy be implemented as an inline Markdown/plain-text copy menu, a persisted default-copy-format preference, or a smaller one-shot plain-text action?
rationale: The source change is likely small, but the issue explicitly offers alternate UX shapes and the plain-text conversion contract affects user expectations for code blocks, links, tables, and lists.

options.title: Copy Menu
options.body: Add a compact copy button menu with Copy as Markdown and Copy as Plain Text actions, leaving any default-format preference for later.

options.title: Persisted Preference
options.body: Add a default copy-format preference and keep the button as a single action, accepting the additional settings and migration/i18n surface.

options.title: No Core Change
options.body: Keep Markdown-only assistant copy behavior and close this as product-out-of-scope if maintainers do not want another Control UI action.

recommendation.title: Copy Menu
recommendation.body: Add a compact copy button menu with Copy as Markdown and Copy as Plain Text actions, leaving any default-format preference for later.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the original copy-as-markdown behavior and have the strongest current history on the affected Control UI copy path.
